nodes.summary: The addition of a set $B$ is left-orderable when there is a strict total order $<$ on $B$ that is invariant under left addition: for all $a, b, c \in B$, if $b < c$ then $a + b < a + c$.
nodes.title: Left-orderable addition

nodes.summary: The multiplication of a set $B$ is left-orderable when there is a strict total order $<$ on $B$ that is invariant under left multiplication: for all $a, b, c \in B$, if $b < c$ then $a b < a c$.
nodes.title: Left-orderable multiplication

nodes.summary: There is a skew brace $B$, that is, a set with two group structures, an addition $+$ and a multiplication $\cdot$, satisfying $a \cdot (b + c) = a \cdot b - a + a \cdot c$ for all $a, b, c \in B$, whose multiplication is left-orderable but whose addition is not left-orderable. That is, the statement of Kourovka Problem 19.49 fails.
nodes.title: A skew brace whose additive group is not left-orderable

nodes.summary: The statement that for every skew brace $B$, that is, a set with two group structures, an addition $+$ (not necessarily commutative) and a multiplication $\cdot$, satisfying $a \cdot (b + c) = a \cdot b - a + a \cdot c$ for all $a, b, c \in B$: if the multiplication of $B$ is left-orderable, then the addition of $B$ is left-orderable.
nodes.title: Left-orderability of the additive group of a skew brace (Kourovka 19.49)

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
